claim: For four children the lower bound is entailed and the upper bound implicated.
evidence_summary: Fourteen chairs can suffice for dinner. A four-child fee band can also exclude a five-child household under negation.
finding: Either local strengthening or an exact analysis with pragmatic weakening needs consideration. The dinner example alone cannot choose.
inference: Does one lower-bound reading locate exactness in pragmatics in every environment?

evidence.source: Richard Breheny (2008). A new look at the semantics and pragmatics of numerically quantified noun phrases. Journal of Semantics 25(2), 93–139.
evidence.passage: §5.2, p. 363. For four children the lower bound is entailed and the upper bound implicated.
evidence.example: Exactness and a lower bound can be distributed differently between semantics and pragmatics.
evidence.establishes: The chair example needs a diagnostic that makes the rival analyses diverge. The fee schedule in the audit is constructed.
evidence.locator: Article comparing accounts of exact and lower-bound numerals.
